title: bot.ability.speaking.draft
description: Words of a reply still being written, to say as they arrive (mosfet.py's speaking draft, decision D262): words newly written into part part after offset characters of it, and, on the part's first draft, its expression. The bot.ability.speaking.input that follows is the reply of record.

part.description: The index of the part in the reply's parts.

words.description: The words newly written into the part; empty for a part that has no words yet.

offset.description: How many characters of the part's words were written before words.

expression.description: How to say the part (an Expression of bot.ability.speaking.input), on its first draft only.
